elements.text:
I am trying to figure out how to effectively use 
AI as a Software Engineer. 

A risk I come across all the time is that it is too 
easy to venture into vibecode-land. 

Contributing to a large-ish production codebase at 
Canary, I often do not trust AI to make the best
decisions. 

I have started to trust it with syntax. I trust it
as a sparring partner, a research tool, and a great
typewriter. 

None of the harnesses I've used so far (and I love 
them), SuperSet, Conductor, Claude, OpenCode 
doesn't expose to me what I actually need.
